definition: נְחֻשְׁתָּן proper name, feminine given to bronze serpent 2Kgs 18:4 probably = bronze -god (so Thes , see also Bau Semitic Rel. i. 288 ; compare נְחַשׁ נְחשֶׁת v 2Kgs 18:4 ; Num 21:9 (twice in verse) ); — chief arg. ag. this are vocalization of ᵐ5 Νεσθαλει , A ᵐ5 L Νε ( ε ) σθαν , and comparative unimportance of material of which image was made; others think of נָחָשׁ serpent ( Nö ZMG xlii (1888), 482 תן + נחשׁ , Klo on the passage יתן + נחשׁ ); Lag BN 188, 205 thinks loan-word
